column1: Producer (1st & between) workflow
column31:
All producers of a value chain need the possibility to mark their work step as done. Its essential to make a difference between the 

* 1st producer
* last producer
* the producers between the 1st and last producer.

This workflow, *dependendly on the value chain and the sequence of the producer*, ensures that the last producer can mark production as complete and upload the delivery bill.



*The 1st producer, beginning work step:*

* Step 01: 
** As a producer, I am in the “Auftragsübersicht” menu item. I get a tabular overview of my orders. I click on the details of “Kommode Alpha” (status “In Bearbeitung”), as I have been notified by producer 01 to start processing. The line is highlighted in green until I click on the “Bearbeitung starten” button in the details.
* Step 02: 
** I am in the order overview of the product. The “Bearbeitung starten” button is {color:#00b8d9}enabled{color}. The “Bearbeitung beenden” button is {color:#ff5630}disabled{color}. I click on “Bearbeitung starten”.
* Step 03
** A pop-up opens with a message that processing is starting. I click on “Bestätigen”.
** Buttons “Abbrechen” ({color:#00b8d9}enabled{color}), “Bestätigen” ({color:#00b8d9}enabled{color})
* Step 04
** The status in the second line changes to “In Bearbeitung”. The “Start editing” button is disabled because editing has already been started and the “Bearbeitung beenden” button is {color:#00b8d9}enabled{color}.
* Step 05
**  I navigate back to the order overview. The line is no longer highlighted. The status “In Bearbeitung” remains as long as other producers are busy processing.

*The 1st producer, finishing work step:*

* Step 01:
** I click on the “Bearbeitung beenden” button (enabled).
* Step 02: A pop-up opens with a message that the editing is finished. I click on “Confirm”.
** Buttons “Abbrechen” (enabled), “Bestätigen” (enabled)
* Step 03: 
** The “Abgeschlossen” status is adopted in the table for the commissioned value chain. The “End processing” button is disabled. As I am responsible for another work step in the value chain, the “Start processing” button is enabled again. The highlight in the corresponding line in the order overview is also adopted again to remind me that I still have to complete a work step in this order.



*The 2nd producer, beginning work step:*

* Step 01: 
** As a producer, I am in the “Auftragsübersicht” menu item. I get a tabular overview of my orders. I click on the details of “Kommode Alpha” (status “In Bearbeitung”), as I have been notified by producer 01 to start processing. * Step 03

** Buttons “Abbrechen” ({color:#00b8d9}enabled{color}), “Bestätigen” ({color:#00b8d9}enabled{color})
* Step 04
** The status in the second line changes to “In Bearbeitung”. The “Start editing” button is disabled because editing has already been started and the “Bearbeitung beenden” button is {color:#00b8d9}enabled{color}.
* Step 05
**  I navigate back to the order overview. The line is no longer highlighted. The status “In Bearbeitung” remains as long as other producers are busy processing.

*The 2nd producer, finishing work step:*

* Step 01:
** I click on the “Bearbeitung beenden” button (enabled).
* Step 02: A pop-up opens with a message that the editing is finished. I click on “Confirm”.
** Buttons “Abbrechen” (enabled), “Bestätigen” (enabled)

column1: Error when final States of a product have the same name
column31:
When creating a product and selecting the same name for final states in different Material Groups this causes some problems, as those final state are used as variant selector in the shop. 
So when Importing Products to the shop this causes some technical error as we’re selecting/searching for those (as distinct assumed) final state names. 
Also for the shop customer this behaviour isn’t ideal, as there would be variant selectors with the same name.

To prevent this problem we need a check when creating a product at least on the backend site, to not create multiple final states with the same name. If the backend is provided with such faulty data a user friendly exception should be shown.

On the frontend site we then need no adaption, as this userfriendly exception would be shown when trying to save the product.

column1: Info Popup when adding product production state is blocked
column31:
There’s no story nor existing design for this.
But when a producer or admin is currently adding a product production state this functionality needs to be blocked for all other producers/admins between the adjacent states.

So when a user tries to add a state at the exact same position a popup should be displayed with some message like:

German:
{{An dieser Position wird gerade ein weitere Zustand von einem anderen Nutzer hinzugefügt. Bitte versuche es in einigen Minuten noch einmal.}}

English:
{{Another state is currently being added at this position by another user. Please try again in a few minutes.}}



This Popup can only be closed (via cross icon on top right or some ‘ok’ button), there is no action being performed.

----

h2. Technical Information

Before opening the wizard for adding a new state we need to check for any db locks. If there is one the described popup should show up.

This workflow is not only available for producers, but also for admins.

When timer runs out the popup should close automatically and discard all inputs. 

The button on the right to the timer should reset the timer itselfe.

----

h2. Technical Information

* This Workflow should be available for producers and admins so we need to add a specific permission to those roles.
* Those suggestions you see on page 5 are made from every existing State we have in our database, regardless of product affiliation. These suggestions should help to uniform state descriptions across all products.
* When one producer/admin is adding a new state all other users shouldn’t be able to add a state between the same states as the current producer/admin. Therefore we need some sort of db lock on these two adjacent states. This lock should be removed automatically after 5min.
* We need two additional endpoints via which the db lock can be removed and the time for locking the db can be rested.

column1: Error Message in Form Inputs
column31:
There was a change request in [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-177|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-177|smart-link].

(Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/66bf393a-bc9e-445c-8679-9e47bc51f80c-33ec/screen/b35e3565-b86a-428e-83ad-4a87a9345822/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/66bf393a-bc9e-445c-8679-9e47bc51f80c-33ec/screen/b35e3565-b86a-428e-83ad-4a87a9345822/|smart-link] )


Error Message should be presented whenever one required input field is without value when clicking on save. 

----

h3. Technical Info

Most input fields already have a property for error messages. This can be used for our purposes to be shown beneath each input, when error message is present.

To prevent the input fields from jumping (error message present or not) it might be an idea to have an empty placeholder for this message to be shown always, but not visible because it’s empty. 

But there might also be other (better) solutions to this. Just have a look at the design and adjust the spacing between inputs so that an error wouldn’t result in any changes to the frontend apart from the message itself being shown.

column1: UserFriendly Exceptions are not shown in the frontend
column31:
I noticed that we don’t show {{UserFriendlyExceptions}} on the frontend side when thrown by the backend.
We have implemented a so called HTTP-Interceptor which is there for intercepting every response of every request we do to our backend. This is for parsing those responses and output them in a abp zero styled format to be read properly by other services (e.g. service proxy functions). 

While intercepting those responses it is also checking for possible errors and showing those errors. We copied a custom implementation of this interceptor which is overriding two functions of this interceptor ({{handleNonAbpErrorResponse}} and {{handleAbpResponse}}). 

You can find the base interceptor in 
{{hsu-client/node_modules/abp-ng2-module/esm2022/lib/interceptors/abp-http-configuration.service.mjs}} 
custom implementation can be found here:
{{hsu-client/src/shared/service-proxies/zero-template-http-configuration.service.ts}}

My guess is that there’s something wrong with the {{this.showError(...}} function we call in line 77 within {{handleAbpResponse}} in our custom (zero) implementation.

The http interceptor, or at least sweet alert seems to work on the login page (just provide wrong credentials and you’ll see this):

!Screenshot 2024-01-25 at 09.00.57.png|width=1046,height=774!

But when providing an email within the profile view, which already exists in the user base i don't get that message (see the error message in the network tab):

column1: Rendering und Events von allen Sub-Components in die Diagramm Basis Komponente hinzufuegen
column31:
* Die JS Events vom Canvas muessen an die Sub-Components weiter gereicht werden fuer das Event Handling innerhalb der Sub-Components. Hierfuer sind 2 Event Gruppen zu definieren fuer die Events {{click}}. {{hover}}, {{mouseMove}}, {{mouseExit}} (ggf. noch touch events etc hinzufuegen). Diese Events sollen vor allem die Maus poition und den type vom Event an die jeweilige Function {{handleClickEvents}} bzw {{handleHoverEvents}} weitergeben. Da das eigentliche handling innerhalb der Sub-Component geschieht muss nur noch auf das result geachtet werden, da hier ggf ein {{ReRendering}} oder {{preventDefault}} definiert wird.
** {{ReRendering}} soll die Render function erneut aufrufen. Wichtig ist hierbei rekursionen zu vermeiden ^^
** {{preventDefault}} soll den jeweiligen events mit an die Sub-Component uebergeben werden, damit diese weiss, ob sie noch auf das Event aktiv reagieren soll oder nicht. Dies verhindert klicks auf hintereinander liegenden Components.
* Positionierung der Sub-Components vornehmen anhand der {{update}} function
* Rendering der Sub-Components implementieren.
* Post-Rendering der Sub-Components implementieren

column1: Connection Sub-Component erstellen

* {{anchor}} property und deren interface definieren ({{side}} und {{target}})
* Event Handling in den functionen {{handleClickEvents}} und {{handleHoverEvents}} definieren. Diese sollen am ende die {{onHover}} und {{onClick}} Event Callbacks aufrufen.
* Functions {{onClick}}, {{onHover}} definieren und die entsprechenden States setzen.
* {{render}} function definieren.
** Rendering vom default Connection, active connection
* {{postRender}} function definieren.
** Rendering von den Hover Buttons
* {{update}} function definieren fuer die Berechnung der Connection groesse (kann vermutlich einfach auf 0 gesetzt werden)

This Ticket is about implementing the producers workflow for accepting/declining a product planning request.

----

h2. Technical Information

In [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-309|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-309|smart-link] we introduced a new status for producer-product assignments. column1: Create workflow for requesting producers to assist in the planning.
column31:
This tickets realises 2 Design-Stories.
As an admin, I can invite producers to participate in the production planning:

Design Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-46|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-46|smart-link]

Design [https://xd.adobe.com/view/a2b0a02a-5f93-493a-8f0b-8659106ba113-f7e3/screen/a94383c6-8511-4db6-bc05-8b04e2d6b3d8/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/a2b0a02a-5f93-493a-8f0b-8659106ba113-f7e3/screen/a94383c6-8511-4db6-bc05-8b04e2d6b3d8/|smart-link] 

When requesting those producers a deadline for their planning is set. The frontend part for this was implemented in [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-313|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-313|smart-link] 

As a producers, I get an email when i get invited to the productions planning:

Design Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-100|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-100|smart-link] 

Email-Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/84d5ef6e-55e5-4509-8b6b-6bd501b3aecf-d186/screen/0e77f3fd-2355-4db4-a50a-f1cdaf004d2d/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/84d5ef6e-55e5-4509-8b6b-6bd501b3aecf-d186/screen/0e77f3fd-2355-4db4-a50a-f1cdaf004d2d/|smart-link] 

----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Backend

For requesting producers the database strucure was already prepared within [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-308|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-308|smart-link] . So there should be an additional table where producers are assigned to one or more products. This table just needs to be altered, as we have to store the deadline date within this table as well (so each producer - product assignment as stored the deadline for this producer).

So the endpoint for requesting producers has to take care of the following things:

* assign producers to product and set deadline via the corresponding table
* set the assignment status
* send an email to each producer

h3. EMail

For the email template the following information are needed for each producer:

* User Name
* processing deadline
* link to products product detail page

column1: As Producer I only see the products, which I am invited to plan or which I am participating in its production.
column31:
I’m logged in as a producer and see the product overview table. Within this table I see only the products that are assigned to me. The table is extended and shows the deadline for production planning. That’s the deadline until which I can add and adjust working steps via the product detail page to the production planning canvas.

Design User Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-28|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-28|smart-link] 

Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/c8dc788a-2d98-4cf1-ad9e-f498142cc772-9d8f/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/c8dc788a-2d98-4cf1-ad9e-f498142cc772-9d8f/|smart-link] 

----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Backend

* We need a table in the database with which we can assign multiple producers to one product
** it's an n to n relationship as on producer can be assigned to multiple products
** this table should have the following fields:
*** productID (FID)
*** producerID (FID)
*** processing deadline
*** assignmentStatus
* The assignment Status is needed as a producer will be able to approve or decline assignments (see [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-314|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-314|smart-link]) The statuses are documented here: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HSU/pages/3754655780/Filter-Optionen#Filter---Produkt%C3%BCbersicht---Produzenten-Anfragen-(Rolle%3A-Admin)|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HSU/pages/3754655780/Filter-Optionen#Filter---Produkt%C3%BCbersicht---Produzenten-Anfragen-(Rolle%3A-Admin)|smart-link] 
* The workflow for assigning producers to products will be implemented with [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-309|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-309|smart-link] 
* The endpoint for producer overview should be adjusted to just return products assigned to the current producer where the producer approved the assignment (see assignment status). 
** If a producer has not yet approved the assignment, the corresponding product should only be listed if the processing deadline is due today or in the future.

h3. Frontend

* The Frontend Table for producers needs to be altered, as this one now will have a new column ‘Bearbeitungsfrist’ ( Processing Deadline). This can be achieved by implementing a {{producer-product-table.service}} for the {{product-table-base.service}}

column31:
Design Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-157|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-157|smart-link] 

Design Link: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/2f29a704-5fed-4707-8d57-810b1e9d39e7-7a7a/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/2f29a704-5fed-4707-8d57-810b1e9d39e7-7a7a/|smart-link] 

Keep in mind, the product wizard in this design story is outdated. The one we implemented with [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-200|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-200|smart-link] is the correct one.

----

h2. Technical Information

When clicking on the edit button of product details sidebar, the developer product creation wizard should open. And the admin should be able to go through all the steps and adjust all data like the developer was.

Therefore we need to refactor a few things especially in the backend.

h3. Backend

Things we have to check and probably adjust:

* all routes should be not only callable by a developer but also by the admin
* not sure if this as to implemented, but the admin will only be able to alter product data after the product was handed in again by one developer, e.g. status > In process developer

h3. Frontend

This should be pretty straight forward. The developer product creation wizard is already implemented and can be reused here to show/change all product data.

There are only a few differences:

* the title prefix should be ‘Produktdetails’ (product details)
* there is no banner
* there is no description
* the button on the last step changed in text, the handling should be the same: e.g. the routes for saving and handing in the product should be called. The latter won't change anything at the product, but validate all the steps.

column31:
Design Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-21|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-21|smart-link] 

* see  number 2 of step 2 for this story

Design Link: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/4b6cca74-1250-424c-8c3c-3ab8c470fe13-1e3f/screen/80dbd9f1-b489-4d52-a87f-b4837f78204e/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/4b6cca74-1250-424c-8c3c-3ab8c470fe13-1e3f/screen/80dbd9f1-b489-4d52-a87f-b4837f78204e/|smart-link] 



As an admin i open the ‘product details page’ for one product and see a table with the head ‘Produzenten Anfragen’ (request producers), listing all producers. Within this list i can select producers to request them for being part of the production planning process.

I cannot search or filter this table, but i can sort it and it should have a pagination.

This ticket is just about implementing this table as described above and not implementing the button ‘Produzenten anfragen’ (request producers), nor the datepicker or any other component for this page.



----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Backend

* we need a new route like the {{GetAllProducts}} route which provides all producers providing sorting and pagination
** later this endpoint will also have to provide searching and filtering, but this will be done in a different ticket later on

h3. Frontend

* For this design we need a new component in the library
* when integrating it in the existing product details page keep in mind that the functionalities for actually requesting producers should not be implemented yet. It’s just about displaying those producers data.

column31:

Design Link: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/4b6cca74-1250-424c-8c3c-3ab8c470fe13-1e3f/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/4b6cca74-1250-424c-8c3c-3ab8c470fe13-1e3f/|smart-link] 

This Ticket is about developing the sidebar with the productdetails.

The sidebar should display all relevant Productinformation like shown in the design. This sidebar is collabsible via the button on the top right.

Have a look into the styleguide for this behaviour as well: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/77778972-da0f-4a7a-b876-68ac03d1e86f-2224/screen/226bcc35-1c12-47e3-88d2-5f63be07b605/specs/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/77778972-da0f-4a7a-b876-68ac03d1e86f-2224/screen/226bcc35-1c12-47e3-88d2-5f63be07b605/specs/|smart-link] 

For the closed state of that sidebar you can have a look at this design:

* Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-22|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-22|smart-link] 
* Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/f145949c-61d6-477b-be4d-bda66497c265-a416/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/f145949c-61d6-477b-be4d-bda66497c265-a416/|smart-link] 



In addition to the product information a list with all provided files by the developer should be displayed together with a button to download all these files at once (as zip file). 

The picture at the bottom of this sidebar should be the +*first*+ of the product pictures, provided in Step 5 of the developer product creation wizard ([https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-200|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-200|smart-link]). 

----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Backend

* We need a route which provides all necessary product information like 
** General information
** Material Groups
** Product Variants
** Description
** List of all uploaded files by category
* We need a route to download all product files at once. I guess at best we zip them first and provide this zip file as download.
* For the frontend the created product details sidebar component should be integrated into a new client component which takes care of the product details page for an admin (there will be different pages for developer and producer) and fetching all data needed from the backend.
** At best there is one general component in addition which takes care of figuring out which role (or permission) the current user has and bind the role specific product details page accordingly

column1: Create Producer Profile
column31:
As a producer i need to be able to input my data, so that I can be contacted and payouts can be send as well as product prices be calculated.

The detailed information of this story can be found here: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-252|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-252|smart-link] 

Design-Link: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/3d5cb6d9-5524-4ef5-8219-f738f619f2c6-680f/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/3d5cb6d9-5524-4ef5-8219-f738f619f2c6-680f/|smart-link] 



----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Backend

In this Popup we see information from which a few are producer specific. For example one developer will not have some hourly wage nor any of these star parameters.

So i was thinking if it would make sense to put all these user information in one custom table. So that we would end up with three different tables for our three roles. This is just a suggestion. Not sure if it would make sense.

These star parameters (value chain parameters) are not fixed by name yet. We can go with 

* Soziales engagement (social commitment)
* Nachhaltigkeit (sustainability)
* Familienfreundlich (family friendly) for now.

For these we have to have a separate table, as those are editable by the admin later.

We need one route to fetch and one to save all the producer profile data.



The fields ‘Gewerk (trade)’ and Status are set by the admin, and not the user. Therefore the need to be fetched, but not saveable.

  

h3. Frontend

* We need a new component for this producer profile popup
* this popup needs to integrated into the {{app.component.html}}

The fields ‘Gewerk (trade)’ and Status are always disabled for this user.

Design Link: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/702cda57-4349-48fa-910d-dcc072b2ff1d-257f/screen/11778d52-b07f-4324-a7c6-209cc233bdd4/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/702cda57-4349-48fa-910d-dcc072b2ff1d-257f/screen/11778d52-b07f-4324-a7c6-209cc233bdd4/|smart-link] 

Excerpt from Design Story with important notices:

* we got 5 instead of 4 steps now
* info text of variant text was updated

*Handling of Step 4:*
_I am in the fourth step of the "Size ranking" pop-up. I can see the following:_

* _Steps of the pop-up (1. general information, 2. material groups, 3. product variants, 4. size ranking (active), 5. file upload)._
* _A notification from the admin (banner)_
** _The notification can be removed via an "X" (but would be displayed again when the pop-up is called up again)_
* _An info text_
* _A table in which all variants of the product sizes that I have previously defined are listed. The standard variant is highlighted in green. The table contains the following columns:_
** _Drag and drop icon_
** _Position_
*** _Positioning from "1 - minimum specification" to "X - maximum specification" (number depends on the number of variants) → The positioning should be able to adapt dynamically_
*** _Height in cm_
*** _Width in cm_
*** _Depth in cm_
* _Buttons "Cancel" (enabled), "Save details"(enabled), "Back to step 3" (enabled), "Continue to step 5"(enabled)_

_I drag and drop the last table row to the front position._

_The order of the product sizes has been updated accordingly. The ranking has been dynamically adjusted. The product standard remains highlighted in green._

_As soon as the product sizes are in the correct order, I click on "Save details" and close the wizard._

----

h2. Technical Information

The library to sort these table entries can be found here: [https://material.angular.io/cdk/drag-drop/overview#customizing-the-drag-placeholder|https://material.angular.io/cdk/drag-drop/overview#customizing-the-drag-placeholder|smart-link] 

The backend needs to provide two endpoints for this: 

* One to get all measurements at once with positions if it already had been saved before
* one to save the the order e.g. positions for each measurement

For the frontend part the component for this step should be part of the library, but you can import the library for storing in our library to complete the frontend part here. So that the client later on will only contain business logic.

*Price:* Free

*Branch:* _feature/HSU-276-jointjs_
*Story:* JointJS

{color:#36b37e}*Pro*{color}

* Lots of customizations
* Good enough Event-System that provides all data needed to be able to define new Events for e.g. clicking a specific area of a rectangle
* Custom elements can be defined
* Collision detection for Link lines (they are displayed in a way that does not go over existing elements)

*Neutral*

* Good documentation, though they use in a lot of the examples for more advanced usage of their library only the paid version, even when it would be also possible with the free version, wich makes it hard to get started.
* Design is not 100% possible to implement

** Link lines are strange, they work but their settings are not working as well

* Relatively hard to get started at first
* Elements are not positioned automatically
* Events can’t be bound to markup components of a custom element

column1: [FE] Developer Product Wizard - File Upload
column31:
Within this step the Developer should provide Files for several Categories to allow the Producer planning the Production process of this Product in a later stage. Therefore one Developer can drag&drop or select files to upload via upload fields for several categories. In addition a product description and also a link to a sharepoint with all product files should be provided.

{panel:bgColor=#deebff}
The Design Story about the functionality of this step can be found here:

[https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-265|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-265|smart-link] 

The original story for this feature can be found here. Although there where change requests to that, so for implementing this feature the one above should be used [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-18|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-18|smart-link]

*Especially the handling from Step 5 onwards is about this feature.*

The Design itself can be found here: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/50389cc1-7d26-4963-ae37-e438ed024cd3-056b/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/50389cc1-7d26-4963-ae37-e438ed024cd3-056b/|smart-link] 
{panel}



----

h2. Technical Information

* Keep in mind that the components for the UploadField [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-63|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-63|smart-link] and UploadCard [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-61|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-61|smart-link]are already done.
* All files already been uploaded for this product should be displayed in some ‘Tag-Cloud’ beneath all upload fields. Each file can be deleted by clicking the 'X' of the corresponding Tag (UploadCardComponent).
* Data for Description and the Sharepoint link should be passed as NgModel. The files itself are uploaded immediately when selecting/dropping them.
* As library for handling the upload functionalities you can use this one [https://github.com/valor-software/ng2-file-upload|https://github.com/valor-software/ng2-file-upload|smart-link] (it’s not part of the project yet, so you have to install it). 
* Saving should be available when there is at least one file in each required category.



{panel:bgColor=#deebff}
The ‘Hand in Product’ Button will be implemented by [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-201|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-201|smart-link]. However to implement this ticket correctly i share the functionality of that button here as well:

The should be enabled, in the same manner like saving(when there is at least one file in each category being uploaded)

* When handing in the product, first the given information should be saved (description and link)
* Then the user should see a popup and confirm the hand in of that product
* After that the product should be updated with a new state
{panel}

column1: [BE] Upload Controller
column31:
We need a backend Controller which can take one or multiple files to upload to the server. For each call of this controller there will be this array of files and one category. After storing the files there has to be a database entry with:

*  the filename 
*  path to the file
* productId (of the product this file belongs to)
* category



The different category types are:

* Produktbeschreibung (product description)
* Produktbilder (product picture)
* Technische Details (technical details)
* Installations- & Nutzungsanweisungen (installation and usage instructions)
* Begleitdokumente und Sonstiges (miscellaneous)
* Modelle und Zeichnungen (models and drawings)
* Herstellungshinweise (manufacturing hints)



For the upload controller you can have a look at innotec, as they already implemented a custom upload controller: [https://github.com/pmagentur/innotec-platform/blob/development/backend/src/PmInnotec.Web.Core/Controllers/UploadController.cs|https://github.com/pmagentur/innotec-platform/blob/development/backend/src/PmInnotec.Web.Core/Controllers/UploadController.cs] 

Another two endpoints are needed for deleting and downloading the files



In addition two new endpoints are needed for the file upload step

* {{GetProductFiles}} - to get all the information needed for the file upload step
* {{CreateOrUpdateProductFiles}} - to update description and sharepoint link

* {{client/src/account/auth/zero-refresh-token.service.ts}}
* {{client/src/shared/service-proxies/service-proxy.module.ts}}

Some of these functionalities are already implemented within the {{hsu-client/src/services/account/auth.service.ts}}. From what i understood so far is, that it should be enough to provide a boolean ‘rememberMe = true’ within the  {{AuthenticationModel}}. Not sure if the {{processAuthentication}} function within that same service takes already care of processing the remember me result correctly. 

(E.g. i’m not sure if we store the refreshToken correctly)

column1: How to handle file uploads in asp
column31:
At the end of the Product Creation wizard the developer is required to upload multiple files. There is already a Ticket to create a corresponding component to handle the frontend (see [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-63|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-63|smart-link]). As soon as one drag & drops a file over one of such upload field components the upload should start immediately.
This ticket is about to research on how to handle uploads in asp exactly. The following questions should be answered:

* Where to store files in asp
* What folder structure to use, so that we can store files per Product (do we dump all files in one folder and just access them by filename or do we store all product files in separated folders
** Later on we need to be able to download each file separately but also all files of one product together as zip file
* How to start the upload and how to recognise the upload being finished. 
* What kind of information does the Upload Field Component need to provide (just a file path? Something else, just an event etc.)
** In general think about a way on how to process the upload via this component when integrated in the hsu-client.

Please gather your results in one confluence page and provide the link to that within this ticket (as comment and in the description).

column1: Create new Product as Admin
column31:
As an Admin i’m in the product overview and want to create a new product. I click on the ‘Produkt anlegen’ Button. A new Popup opens where i can add Productinformation like name, developer, description. In the same popup information like productnumber and creationdate are shown. When i open that popup for the first time these two dates are empty. The field for developers is a dropdown from which i can select one.

I got three buttons:

* ‘Cancel/Abbrechen’ → Closes this popup without saving/creating the product data
* ‘Save data/Angaben speichern’ → Closes this popup and saves/creates product data (with state ‘Entwurf’)
* ‘Release product/Produkt freigeben' → Closes this popup and saves/creates product data (with state ‘In Bearbeitung Entwickler’)

Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-3|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-3|smart-link] 

Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/017f7c78-7bd2-431a-9339-0c0cb674f63f-542c/screen/0c5a6bd8-cb7e-4569-8c60-52a76914c444/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/017f7c78-7bd2-431a-9339-0c0cb674f63f-542c/screen/0c5a6bd8-cb7e-4569-8c60-52a76914c444/|smart-link] 

----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Frontend - Header

The Product overview needs a new Header which contains the title and a new button to create products. For this you can use the {{pm-header}} component (-> [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-115|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-115|smart-link]). 

When i click ‘create’ button the popup from [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-226|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-226|smart-link] should open. 

When i click one product in my table with the state ‘Entwurf’ the same popup should open but with the corresponding product data as input (see [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-227|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-227|smart-link] for the corresponding route).

For the three button events the following behaviour should be implemented (see [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-227|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-227|smart-link] for routes):

* cancel → Popup closes without saving data /  creating product
* save → save data / create product (state ‘Entwurf’) and on success close popup
* release →  save data / create product (state ‘In Bearbeitung Entwickler’) and on success close popup

h3. Frontend - PopUp

We need a new  layout component which takes care of this Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/017f7c78-7bd2-431a-9339-0c0cb674f63f-542c/screen/0c5a6bd8-cb7e-4569-8c60-52a76914c444/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/017f7c78-7bd2-431a-9339-0c0cb674f63f-542c/screen/0c5a6bd8-cb7e-4569-8c60-52a76914c444/|smart-link] . This popup should take some {{ProductModel}} as ngModel to handle in- and output of data for this component in one sweep. 
On how to implement ngModel with custom components have a look here: [https://angular.io/guide/two-way-binding|https://angular.io/guide/two-way-binding|smart-link] 

This Popup has three Buttons: 

* {{Cancel/Abbrechen}}
* {{Save data/Angaben speichern}}
* {{Release product/Produkt freigeben}}

Upon clicking anyone of them an event should be fired.

h3. Backend

For this story to work we need the following Backend routes

* {{GetDevelopers}} Route which returns all Developer users within our application
** For now the corresponding DTO just has to contain id, name and surename of that user
* {{GetProduct}} This route should return all information of the {{Product}} Entity.
* {{CreateProduct}} This route should save all informations given in this popup (name, developer, description). On saving we need to create a new productnumber and set creationdate for that product.
* {{SaveProduct}} This route should save all informations given in this popup (name, developer, description).

This probably would result into one profile route for each role, which would be fine for me. However, if possible try create one endpoint for all profiles which returns different data based on that current users role.

For this role we need one route to fetch and one to save their profile data. 

The properties ‘name’, ‘name (pseudonym)' and ‘status’ are always disabled and therefore just need to be fetched and not saved.

h3. Frontend

* we need a developer profile popup component
* this popup needs to be integrated into the {{app.compnent.html}}

The properties ‘name’, ‘name (pseudonym)' and ‘status’ are always disabled.

column1: Create Background Card Base Component
column31:
We need a base component for our Background Card and Popup Components which is generic and reusable.

This component should take care of the base styling (background, border, header).

* The header is optional, as it can also be used without any header
* This base component should have two optional parameters for the card itself being collapsible or closable
* When collapsible this component should show an arrow icon button which collapses the content area on click
* When closable this component should show an close icon button which fires an event on click
* Next to this two (optional) buttons there should be an {{<ng-content>}} area which can take additional components to display (like seen in the design for the background card).
* On the bottom of this component there should be two additional {{<ng-content>}} areas two display buttons. One on the right, and one on the left (have a look at the popup design for that).

For better understanding see the following Designs:

* [Popup|https://xd.adobe.com/view/77778972-da0f-4a7a-b876-68ac03d1e86f-2224/screen/d3439fc0-406b-45a9-99c1-1a85233e44cb/specs/]

An example on how to use {{ng-content}} in Angular you can find in the {{pm-grid}} component:

column1: Create Pop-Up: product hand in to admin
column31:
As a product designer/engineer I need to be able to hand in the all of the product details to the admin for him to review and prepare for planning by the producers.

*Step 01:* As a developer, I am in the "Produktübersicht" menu item. I get a tabular overview of my products ([https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-14|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-14|smart-link] ). I have already edited the product "Kommode Alpha" and would now like to complete the editing. I click on the table row to access the editing details.

*Step 02:* A pop-up opens. I am shown the data I have already entered and I can either jump directly to the last step using the step navigation or navigate using the "Next" buttons at the bottom of the pop-up.

*Step 03*: I click on the fourth step of the step navigation and see the files already entered here as well. I click on the "Produkt einreichen" button.

*Step 04*: A new pop-up opens with a hint or a security question. Here I can click "Produkt einreichen" again to make sure that the click on the previous button was not an accident.

*Step 05*: The view changes back to the product overview. The product "Kommode Alpha" receives the status "Bereit für Wertkettenplanung". It can now still be viewed, but no longer edited.

[https://xd.adobe.com/view/3638c49c-04ca-4b7a-b1e3-357683196a8d-636b/screen/acb5fa12-b343-4753-936e-c0fab22297f8/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/3638c49c-04ca-4b7a-b1e3-357683196a8d-636b/screen/acb5fa12-b343-4753-936e-c0fab22297f8/|smart-link] 

*Button Actions:* 
*Abbrechen/Cancel:* When clicking on this button the pop up is closed and the product wizard stays opened. 

*Speichern/Save:* When clicking on this button the product is handed in for review. The developer cant edit any information on product anymore, he can only view the product details by browsing through the wizard. The textfields are disabled.



*X/Close:* Same behaviour as the Cancel Action.

----

*Technical Notes:*

When handing in the product at this point all information should already be validated, except for changes/new information on the last step. So The button ‘hand in product’ should be disabled as long as the current provided data are not valid. This should be implemented by [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-200|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-200|smart-link] .

So for the popup on clicking ‘Product einreichen’ within the popup several things should happen:

* Data from the last step should be saved
* When this was successful, the product status should be updated to ‘Bereit für Wertkettenplanung’ (according to this overview: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HSU/pages/3754655780/Filter-Optionen|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HSU/pages/3754655780/Filter-Optionen|smart-link] ) 
* The popup should close and the table data has to be reloaded to get the product with it’s new state (otherwise one would be able to open the product creation wizard again)

column31:
Within this step the Developer should provide Files for several Categories to allow the Producer planning the Production process of this Product in a later stage. Therefore one Developer can drag&drop or select files to upload via upload fields for several categories. In addition a product description and also a link to a sharepoint with all product files should be provided.

{panel:bgColor=#deebff}
The Design Story about the functionality of this step can be found here:

[https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-265|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-265|smart-link] 

The original story for this feature can be found here. Although there where change requests to that, so for implementing this feature the one above should be used [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-18|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-18|smart-link]

*Especially the handling from Step 5 onwards is about this feature.*

The Design itself can be found here: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/50389cc1-7d26-4963-ae37-e438ed024cd3-056b/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/50389cc1-7d26-4963-ae37-e438ed024cd3-056b/|smart-link] 
{panel}



----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Frontend

* Keep in mind that the components for the UploadField [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-63|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-63|smart-link] and UploadCard [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-61|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-61|smart-link]are already done.
* All files already been uploaded for this product should be displayed in some ‘Tag-Cloud’ beneath all upload fields. Each file can be deleted by clicking the 'X' of the corresponding Tag (UploadCardComponent).
* Data for Description and the Sharepoint link should be passed as NgModel. The files itself are uploaded immediately when selecting/dropping them.
* As library for handling the upload functionalities you can use this one [https://github.com/valor-software/ng2-file-upload|https://github.com/valor-software/ng2-file-upload|smart-link] (it’s not part of the project yet, so you have to install it). 
* Saving should be available when there is at least one file in each required category.



{panel:bgColor=#deebff}
The ‘Hand in Product’ Button will be implemented by [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-201|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-201|smart-link]. However to implement this ticket correctly i share the functionality of that button here as well:

The should be enabled, in the same manner like saving(when there is at least one file in each category being uploaded)

* When handing in the product, first the given information should be saved (description and link)
* Then the user should see a popup and confirm the hand in of that product
* After that the product should be updated with a new state
{panel}



h3. Backend

We need a backend Controller which can take one or multiple files to upload to the server. For each call of this controller there will be this array of files and one category. After storing the files there has to be a database entry with:

*  the filename 
*  path to the file
* productId (of the product this file belongs to)
* category



The different category types are:

* Produktbeschreibung (product description)
* Produktbilder (product picture)
* Technische Details (technical details)
* Installations- & Nutzungsanweisungen (installation and usage instructions)
* Begleitdokumente und Sonstiges (miscellaneous)
* Modelle und Zeichnungen (models and drawings)
* Herstellungshinweise (manufacturing hints)



For the upload controller you can have a look at innotec, as they already implemented a custom upload controller: [https://github.com/pmagentur/innotec-platform/blob/development/backend/src/PmInnotec.Web.Core/Controllers/UploadController.cs|https://github.com/pmagentur/innotec-platform/blob/development/backend/src/PmInnotec.Web.Core/Controllers/UploadController.cs]

column1: Create View: Product creation product variants
column31:
As a developer I’m in the product creation process and already entered information regarding product measurements and material groups being used. Now I want to enter variants for this product. I can enter variants regarding those information in the previous tow steps (measurements and material groups). For these two kinds of variants I see two columns (‘Abweichende Größen’ and ‘Abweichende Materialien’) in which I can add new variants. 

When clicking on the plus beneath ‘Abweichende Größen’ three new input fields (height, width, depth) for this new variant are added. All of them are required, so as soon as I added the input fields, the save button and next step button are disabled (they’ll enable again after I entered all required fields). 

Something similar happens for ‘Abweichende Materialien’. Clicking on that Plus Button ads tow new fields. In the first I can select a material group from the previous step, in the second I can add a new Name for the Material variant. Save and next buttons are disabled in the same way like for ‘Abweichende Größen’. The plus buttons are also disabled as long as I didn’t fill out the previous variant. And in addition next to each variant there is a delete button for this variant in the shape of a bin button.



Design Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-17|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-17|smart-link] 

Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/614a6aa9-3896-4200-a2dc-70ee916f74cd-3419/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/614a6aa9-3896-4200-a2dc-70ee916f74cd-3419/|smart-link] 

----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Backend - Entities

* All Variants for the Measurements of one product should be stored in the same table as the default {{Measurement}} but with the flag {{default}} set to {{false}}
* For Material Variants we need a new Entity {{MaterialVariant}} which has the following properties:
** {{id}}
** {{materialId}}
** {{description}}

h3. Backend - Endpoints

* For Measurement Variants we will reuse the {{CreateOrUpdate}} and {{Get}} Endpoints of the Material created in [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-216|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-216|smart-link]
** In addition we need one Endpoint to delete {{ProductMeasurments}}.
* For the newly create {{MaterialVariant}} Entity we need the same Endpoints ({{CreateOrUpdate}} , {{Get}} ) and in Addition one Endpoint for Deleting these Variants. 



h3. Frontend

We need a new Component for this Product creation Step, which can be used together with the {{pm-wizard}} component ([https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-215|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-215|smart-link]) within the product overview. 

* For ‘Abweichend Größen’  (Variants for {{ProductMeasuremnt}}) you can have a look at the component for the first step of this wizard ([https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-222|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-222|smart-link]) and reuse the structure for the three input fields.
* For ‘Abweichende Materialien’ (Variants for {{MaterialVariants}}) there should be a dropdown where the developer can select a material from the previous step and an input field for a name/description for this new variant. Next to each entry there is a delete button which should delete that entry.

For both rows plus buttons are disabled as long as there is on entry with invalid/missing data, also saving is disabled as long as there are invalid/missing data in one of these two rows.



h3. Connect Frontend Component and API

In the hsu-client the newly created component should be integrated within the product overview for developers. The component should be integrated as step 3 within the step wizard.

* All Actions like saving measurment/material variants, deleting them and fetching all variants when entering this step should be called accordingly.

column31:
As a product designer i already provided general information for a new product and want to define workpieces within material groups needed for this product. This information is required in order to determine wich industries will be involved in the manufacturing process.

* Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-16|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-16|smart-link] 
* Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/b2c3775d-2901-4bf0-b018-145694fed6a2-e790/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/b2c3775d-2901-4bf0-b018-145694fed6a2-e790/|smart-link] 

The background for providing these Workpieces is, that later when defining the product production process with the producers, they will have to work on each of these Workpieces in individual processes. So each of these Workpieces have a final state with a final outcome. In a last step these Workpieces are then assembled into the final product.

----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Backend

We need new Entities:

*  {{MaterialGroup}}:  Just an Entity to hold some base information which probably won’t change. These Entity is responsible to provide the Base Material categories like 'Holz' (Wood), 'Glas' (glas), 'Metall' (metal). Therefore it should just have an id and name. The name should be the english one, as we will translate these in the frontend
* {{SurfaceFinish}}: For each {{MaterialType}} there are different Surface finishes. This Entity is prefilled with as well. You can find a list with all finishes [here|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HSU/pages/3758817284/Oberfl+chenbeschaffenheiten+der+Materialgruppen] (please ignore the section with Colors/Farben). This Entity needs the following properties:
** {{id}}
** {{name}}
** {{materialGroupId}} => reference to {{MaterialGroup}}

* {{State}}: Represents one of the states in the Productionplan for one product. This entity needs to have the following properties:
** {{id}}
** {{productId}} => reference to {{Products}}
** {{successor}} => reference to itself 
** {{description}}
* {{WorkPiece}}: Represents one part of the final product which needs to be produced by one or more producers of one industry. This Entity has the following entities:
** {{id}}
** {{description}}
** {{surfaceId}} => reference to {{SurfaceFinish}}
** {{materialGroupId}} => reference to {{MaterialGroup}}

When a developer saves the changes made during this step several information should be saved/created:

# For each entry in one of the Material Groups a new Object of {{WorkPiece}} is created
# The initial and final {{State}} of each WorkPiece are created
# The products final {{State}} is created

For this purpose we need a new Endpoint which takes care of that logic.

In Addition we need new Endpoints to fetch all {{SurfaceFinishes}} by {{MaterialGroup}}

Within this step there should be one column for each {{MaterialGroup}} as shown in the Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/b2c3775d-2901-4bf0-b018-145694fed6a2-e790/screen/757c9918-1ab6-43c9-863c-425de62aae99/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/b2c3775d-2901-4bf0-b018-145694fed6a2-e790/screen/757c9918-1ab6-43c9-863c-425de62aae99/|smart-link] .

I am a developer and the admin assigned a new (empty) product to me (which is indicated by the status ‘In Bearbeitung Entwickler’). I click on one of these products with said status in the product overview table. A new popup window with some sort of step wizard opens. In the first step of that wizard i can define measurements for this product. When i click on next step or save my information are saved automatically.  

Design Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-15|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-15|smart-link]

Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/0a3b0b2b-e75c-4ad5-96ee-ac9589be2e4f-5f68/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/0a3b0b2b-e75c-4ad5-96ee-ac9589be2e4f-5f68/|smart-link]  



----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Step Wizard Component

For this to work we need a generalistic component which can take care of some step wizard behaviour as seen in this design for the product creation wizard: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/00f72310-aad8-49bf-a8bb-89819ccd969c-55a4/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/00f72310-aad8-49bf-a8bb-89819ccd969c-55a4/|smart-link] 

The titel for each step should be passed to this component as array

The content for each step should be defined by using {{ng-template}} with some id {{step}} for example. You can find an example for this here: [https://stackoverflow.com/questions/40165294/access-multiple-viewchildren-using-viewchild|https://stackoverflow.com/questions/40165294/access-multiple-viewchildren-using-viewchild|smart-link] (reference for QueryList: [https://angular.io/api/core/QueryList|https://angular.io/api/core/QueryList|smart-link] )

The Buttons within this wizard should also be passed from the outside. You could achieve that similar to the {{ng-templates}} above.

* The two steps buttons should always be given as well as the button on the last step for finalizing the step wizard
* the two other buttons ({{cancel}} and {{save}} in this example) are optional and can be passed as group

h3. Backend

In addition to the current properties the product entity should now be extended by some measurements (Height, Length, Depth). Later on in this process there will be the possibility to set different measurements for one product as variations.

We need the following adjustments to the backend to show the first step of our product creation wizard correctly:

* route to fetch data for one specific product
* create a new entity  {{ProductMeasurements}} (or just {{Measurements}} whatever you think is better) where each product can have multiple measurements.
** measurements should have an additional flag to flag one measurement for each product as the default one
** the measurements defined in this step of the step wizards needs to be flagged as the default one 
* route to fetch the default measurements for one product
* route to save (just) the default measurements for one product



h3. Frontend

The newly created Step Wizard should be integrated into the Developers ProductOverview (-> [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-163|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-163|smart-link]). When i click on one product in that table with the status ‘In Bearbeitung Entwickler’ the step wizard should open with that product information. 

The first step shown is the step where measurements are defined: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/0a3b0b2b-e75c-4ad5-96ee-ac9589be2e4f-5f68/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/0a3b0b2b-e75c-4ad5-96ee-ac9589be2e4f-5f68/|smart-link] . For this step please create a new component.

For passing data between this step and the parent component please use two way binding (see → [https://angular.io/guide/two-way-binding|https://angular.io/guide/two-way-binding|smart-link] )

Also pass title and buttons with the following behaviour to that wizard:

* ‘Abbrechen/Cancel’ → PopUp [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-234|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-234|smart-link] is shown, if user can choose between saving and close or close without saving (saving is only possible when data are valid).
* ‘Angaben speichern/Save data’ → Data is saved if valid and when successful  the wizard closes
* ‘Zurück zu Schritt X’ → this behaviour can not be implemented yet, as we are in step 1)
* ‘Weiter zu Schritt X’ → depending on the step the corresponding save route is called with the given data (when valid) and the wizard moves on one step
* ‘Produkt einreichen’ → this behaviour can’t be implemented yet

column1: Adjust Swagger generated dtos to accept optional parameters
column31:
When defining optional parameters in our Backend Dtos Swagger currently generates {{var?: type | undefined}} variables out of it. These are not optional as you have to initialise them at least with {{undefined}}. 

At innotec they found a way to allow optional parameters in swagger, you can find all corresponding changes here: [https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-innotec/pull/356/files|https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-innotec/pull/356/files]

One Popup should be able to take:

* a title/header with the option to highlight one part of it in grey (the third popup)
* a closing button on the top right
* an optional group of buttons on the bottom right
* an optional button on the bottom left
* both (optional) button groups should be sticky, meaning, if the content above is to much for the popup size to fit, the content should start scrolling and the buttons stick to the bottom.

The content of the Popup is variable and should be included with {{ng-content}}

The content of these popups should be scrollable if too big for the current popup size. When scrolling the tow button groups on the bottom are sticky and should not scroll away, same for the Header and closing button.

column1: Implement Product overview for Developers
column31:
I’m a developer and logged in into the application. The first page i see is the product overview. I can only see the products I am involved in developing. If a status has the status ‘In Bearbeitung Entwickler’ and i click on it a new product creation wizard for that product opens (-> [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-193|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-193|smart-link]).



In all other cases a product detail page with base information should open, *but this is not part of this story.*


----

h2. Technical Information

h3. Frontend

The productoverview component needs to be adjusted to check for the users role (at best create some sort of userInformationService for that). You can query these information within the {{SessionAppService.GetCurrentLoginInformation}} function (-> [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-218|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-218|smart-link]).
On the table when i click on one row and the corresponding product has the state ‘In Bearbeitung Entwickler’ the product wizard should open (-> [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-193|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-193|smart-link]).

h3. Backend - Filter products

For this story we need to adjust the current {{GetProducts}} route to just deliver those products related to the current logged in User. For now we will focus on Developers and Admins:

* Admin can see every product
* developers can just see products they got assigned by the admin

Therefore we also need to be able to set this relation. That’s why the product entity should be extended and get a new {{Developer}} field (one product can only be assigned to one developer, but one developer can be assigned to many products).



h3. Backend - Deliver Roles to Frontend

For this story and also for others in the future we need to access the role of the current user. This should be delivered to the frontend via backen.

There's already one route which delivers user information which just needs to be adjusted:

* {{GetCurrentLoginInformations}} in {{SessionAppService}}

column1: Password forgotten component
column31:
Design Story: [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-106?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiZDBlMzBkN2I2OTIzNDU3OTg2MTg5MmI4YTFhOWVkZjIiLCJwIjoiaiJ9|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-106?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiZDBlMzBkN2I2OTIzNDU3OTg2MTg5MmI4YTFhOWVkZjIiLCJwIjoiaiJ9|smart-link] 

Design: [https://xd.adobe.com/view/8b6f6381-84e5-4cc3-8af2-117cfd6c1e61-de3c/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/8b6f6381-84e5-4cc3-8af2-117cfd6c1e61-de3c/|smart-link] 

h2. Story

* As a(ny) user i have forgotten my password and want to reset that. When clicking on the link ‘password forgotten’ i’m redirected to a page where i have to provide my email address. 
* There are two buttons on that page ‘Zurück’ (Back) and ‘Bestätigen’ (submit). The first one brings me back to the login page, the second one will send an email to my address with a link to reset my password.
* I click on ‘Password zurücksetzen' (password reset) link within that email i got and get to a page where i can set a new password and repeat that password. There are two buttons, the ‘Zurück’ (Back) button brings me back to login page, the ‘Bestätigen’ (Submit) Button resets my password and brings me to the login page as well.


h2. Technical Information

We need several new components:

* {{Request-Password-Mail}} 
** includes the design for entering that email for resetting the password and the popup which opens after clicking submit
* {{Reset-Password}}
** includes the design for providing new password
* an email providing a link to reset my password



Within the {{AccountAppService}} ({{AccountServiceProxy}}) there is a {{sendPasswordResetCode}} function which can be used to send that email. It just needs to be adjusted to use our custom template. Remember to adjust that link being send with this email to our new reset-password route.

For resetting the password you can have a look in {{AccountAppService}} ({{AccountServiceProxy}}) as well and use the existing {{ResetPassword}} function.

column1: Implement Login
column31:
In [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-109|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-109|smart-link] we created a login component which now should be used in a {{login compnent}} in the hsu-client. For this component you can have a look at the default login compnent of asp in {{client/src/account/login}} or the corresponding implementation in [Innotec|https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-innotec/tree/development/innotec-client/src/app/login].

* use the {{pm-login}} component to fetch {{mail}}, {{password}} and {{remember me}} via the login event
* the {{password-reset}}doesn’t need to be implemented yet
* create an own auth service like in Innotec or reuse the existing asp auth service from service.proxies (have a look if it makes sense to create an own auth service)
* while waiting for an auth response use the ngx-spinner (you need to install it in the client via yarn)
** examples on how to use this library you can find in the default client (in the login component e.g.)
* Update the angular routing:
** default route should be the new create login component
** this route should have a redirect guard which redirects to the dashboard if user is already logged in
** every other route should have an access guard which redirects to the login if no user is authenticated

column1: Login Component
column31:
We need a component for logging in into our application. The styling for this component can be found here: 

[https://xd.adobe.com/view/6db2a224-abd8-4478-af5a-7099e15f2fc0-38e1/screen/dbe399b9-b91b-4361-9140-be812e797367/|https://xd.adobe.com/view/6db2a224-abd8-4478-af5a-7099e15f2fc0-38e1/screen/dbe399b9-b91b-4361-9140-be812e797367/|smart-link] 

For the structure of the component itself you can have a look at similar components at [Innotec|https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-innotec/tree/development/innotec-client/src/app/login] or [Hagebau|https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-hagebau-extranet-admin-tools/tree/development/storybook/workspace/projects/hagebau-coremedia/src/lib/layouts/pm-login]. 

* Klicks on the {{Login}} Button link should result into Events beeing emitted.
** The Event for the Login button should have {{mail}}, {{password}} and checkbox value for {{remember me}} as a payload
* You can ignore the {{password-reset}} and {{stay logged in}} functionalities for now.

The Logo can be found here: [https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1lcdjLVXwl3AZycsgXSAhBWe-IABGCdkg|https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1lcdjLVXwl3AZycsgXSAhBWe-IABGCdkg|smart-link] 



This {{pm-login}} Login component than should be used in a {{login}} component within the {{hsu-client}} to implement login similar to the existing one in asp client: {{client/src/account/login}}.

*  On clicking the login button the given user data should be send and checked on the backend site. Therefore you can reuse the existing services in the {{service-proxies}} (have a look in the [innotec client|https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-innotec/blob/development/innotec-client/src/app/login/login-screen.component.ts] on how they are used → notice: we don’t need tenancy support). 
* While waiting for an auth response use the ngx-spinner (you need to install it in the client via yarn) to block the frontend and show a  ‘work’ indicator
** examples on how to use this library you can find in the default client (in the login component e.g.)



Update the angular routing:

* default route should be the new create login component
* this route should have a redirect guard which redirects to the dashboard if user is already logged in
* every other route should have an access guard which redirects to the login if no user is authenticated

An example for this kind of routing can be found in the Innotec Project: [https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-innotec/blob/development/innotec-client/src/app/app-routing.module.ts|https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-innotec/blob/development/innotec-client/src/app/app-routing.module.ts]

04/Sep/23 6:00 PM;712020:81434378-09b7-4502-ab35-c2eecd3c4ddb;[~accountid:628e27a71c97b5006f0bb91c] Die Ansicht passt an sich, ich glaube wir müssten nur wegen der aktiven Aufträge / Auftragsanfragen und der Bearbeitungszeiten nochmal schauen.

Was ich damit meine ist, dass ich ja unterscheiden muss in:

* *neue Fertigungsanfrage* (Kunde hat bestellt, eine Wertkette wurde ausgewählt, die Produzenten dieser ausgewählten Wertkette werden jetzt angefragt) 
→ ich muss ablehnen oder annehmen, habe aber noch keinen Fertigungsauftrag erhalten; 
--> je nach dem, ob die Wertkette zustande kommt wird hieraus eine “abgelehnte Fertigungsanfrage”, eine “abgesagte Fertigungsanfrage”, eine “Fertigungsanfrage on-hold”, oder ein “Fertigungsauftrag” 
--> es muss eine *Bearbeitungsfrist* geben (Größenordnung ca. 2-3 Werktage) 
* *abgelehnte Fertigungsanfrage* (ich wollte/konnte den Auftrag nicht annehmen)
* *abgesagte Fertigungsanfrage* (die Wertkette ist nicht zustande gekommen und auch keine andere, an der ich beteiligt bin)
* *Fertigungsanfrage “on-hold”* (ich habe die Anfrage bestätigt, aber es ist noch keine vollständige Wertkette zustande gekommen)
--> hieraus kann dann eine “abgesagte Fertigungsanfrage” oder ein “Fertigungsauftrag werden
* *aktiver Fertigungsauftrag* (eine Wertkette, an der ich beteiligt bin, wurde vollständig von den Produzenten bestätigt)
→ ich muss mein *Startdatum* und mein *Enddatum* wissen (ich glaub das wären 2 Spalten, die wir hinzufügen sollten)
--> hier könnte man sich verscheidene Phasen überlegen (vielleicht mit farbigen Punkten), also, z.B., “noch nicht begonnen” (wenn das Startdatum in der Zukunft liegt), “in Produktion”, “in Verzug”
* *abgeschlossener Fertigungsauftrag*

(Das ist jetzt erstmal eine vorläufige Auflistung, kann sein, dass ich noch etwas vergessen habe.)



Und noch eine Überlegung, die Bearbeitungszeit in Wochen wird ja vermutlich nicht runtergezählt. Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob das nicht dazu führt, dass die Produzenten die Liste sehen und denken, ach alles gut, ich habe ja noch X Wochen. Sprich ich glaube, dass es aus der aktuellen Darstellung noch nicht deutlich genug hervorkommt, wie viel Zeit ich NOCH habe und was gerade dringend ist. 

Zudem fände ich es noch sinnvoll, den Unterschied zwischen einer “Anfrage” (egal in welchem aktuellen Zustand) und einem fest erteilten “Auftrag” deutlicher zu machen. 

Das geht jetzt aber auch alles in das Thema *auftragsabhängige* Planung über, da sollten wir auf jeden Fall nochmal drüber sprechen :)

To make this table reusable column titles should not be fixed but dynamically assigned. At best you create an own TableHeader type, which takes an id and title as attributes for now. Lateron there will be more dynamic column stuff.

As a reference you can have a look at this component: [https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-hagebau-extranet-admin-tools/tree/development/storybook/workspace/projects/hagebau-coremedia/src/lib/layouts/pm-table|https://github.com/pmphillip/pm-hagebau-extranet-admin-tools/tree/development/storybook/workspace/projects/hagebau-coremedia/src/lib/layouts/pm-table|smart-link] 



Backend: 

We need an entity called product with the following attributes:

* Id
* ProductNumber
* Name
* CreateDate
* ModifyDate
* State

In addition to that there should be an endpoint which returns all available products. Therefore add the corresponding {{ProductAppService}} , {{ProductService}} and `ProductRepository`

Denn dann bräuchten wir noch eine Worklflow mit dem der Admin die Bearbeitung manuell beenden kann oder?
column326:
30/Aug/23 3:00 PM;712020:81434378-09b7-4502-ab35-c2eecd3c4ddb;[~accountid:628e27a71c97b5006f0bb91c] [~accountid:5ef49ab24d302e0ac3183568] Also ich würde jetzt der Einfachheit halber sagen, dass man einfach immer eine Frist setzen muss. Dann brauchen wir keinen separaten Workflow, und außerdem haben wir ja schon angelegt, dass der Admin die Bearbeitungsfrist verändern kann. Wenn wir das so machen, dass die Frist sowohl verlängert, als auch verkürzt werden kann, dann kann ich die Bearbeitungszeit ja prinizpiell immer innerhalb von einem Tag beenden. Sprich wenn das Produkt erstmal nicht drängt, dann setze ich halt eine ewig lange Frist und kürze die dann bei Bedarf.
Dementsprechend würde ich das Pop-up so ändern, dass da eben so etwsa in der Art steht: “Es wurde noch keine Bearbeitungsfrist festgelegt. Bitte lege zuerst eine Frist fest, um das Produkt zur Wertkettenplanung für die Produzenten freigeben zu können. Die Bearbeitungsfrist kann später bei Bedarf jederzeit verkürzt oder verlängert werden.” Und dann je nach dem, wie viel Aufwand das technisch ist, würde ich sagen, dass man entweder direkt im Pop-up die Frist eintragen und das Produkt dann freigeben kann, oder man muss halt nochmal das Pop-up schließen, die Frist eintragen und dann wieder auf den Freigabe Knopf drücken.
Wie seht ihr das, würde das so passen?
column327:
31/Aug/23 9:32 AM;628e27a71c97b5006f0bb91c;[~accountid:712020:81434378-09b7-4502-ab35-c2eecd3c4ddb] [~accountid:5ef49ab24d302e0ac3183568] Das können wir gerne so anpassen. Ich würde es dann in allen Tickets zur Bearbeitungsfrist noch einmal aktualisieren. Ich würde vermuten, dass es recht unkompliziert sein sollte von dem “Hinweis Pop-up” direkt weiter über einen Button zu dem Pop-up mit der Bearbeitungsfrist zu gelangen. Oder liege ich hier falsch [~accountid:5ef49ab24d302e0ac3183568] ?

Alternativ wäre es möglich, den Button “Produzenten anfragen” erst zu enablen, wenn eine Bearbeitungsfrist eingetragen wurde. Allerdings müsste im Beschreibungstext dann auch darauf hingewiesen werden, dass eine Bearbeitungsfrist eingestellt werden muss, um die Produzenten anfragen zu können. Da ist jetzt die Frage welcher Workflow euch lieber ist [~accountid:712020:81434378-09b7-4502-ab35-c2eecd3c4ddb] ? Prinzipiell haben beide Varianten aus Nutzerperspektive Vor- und Nachteile:

* Entweder ist man irritiert (oder sogar frustriert), wenn man den disableten Button sieht, aber den Beschreibungstext vielleicht nicht gelesen hat.
* Andererseits spart man sich einen Klick bzw. ein Pop-up wenn der Button erst enabled wird, sobald die Bearbeitungsfrist eingetragen wurde).
column328: 31/Aug/23 9:36 AM;5ef49ab24d302e0ac3183568;Beide Alternativen sind technisch möglich. Die Alternative mit dem deaktivieren des ‘Produzenten anfragen’ Buttons wäre mit (im Verhältnis wesentlich) weniger Aufwand verbunden. Allerdings ist auch die Popup Variante kein allzu großer Aufwand.

04/Sep/23 3:56 PM;712020:81434378-09b7-4502-ab35-c2eecd3c4ddb;[~accountid:628e27a71c97b5006f0bb91c] [~accountid:5ef49ab24d302e0ac3183568]  Mir ist gerade noch aufgefallen, ich kann ja jetzt sehen, wer seine Zustände schon eingetragen hat, wenn ich in der Graphik hovere. Aber wenn ich jetzt nur kurz sehen möchte, wer von meinen angefragten Produzenten schon etwas bearbeitet hat, geht das ja damit nicht so gut. Kann man das noch in die Produzententabelle als extra Spalte aufnehmen? Also z.B. als verschiedene Stati:  “Angefragt”, “In Bearbeitung”, “Bearbeitung abgeschlossen”, “Abgelehnt”

Würde es noch Sinn machen, das aufzunehmen? (Also z.B. in der letzten Folie in der AdobexD Datei von [https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-30|https://pmsoftware.atlassian.net/browse/HSU-30|smart-link] )
column327:
06/Sep/23 12:17 PM;628e27a71c97b5006f0bb91c;[~accountid:712020:81434378-09b7-4502-ab35-c2eecd3c4ddb]  Wir haben intern schon einmal darüber gesprochen. Deine Anmerkung ist auf jeden Fall sinnvoll, wir würden vorschlagen es folgendermaßen zu lösen: 

* Wir fügen die Stati “Angefragt”, “Abgelehnt” und “Angenommen” hinzu (Das ist aus Entwicklungssicht am besten umsetzbar, denn der Status “In Bearbeitung” verhält sich nochmal etwas anders, weshalb dies einen Mehraufwand bedeuteten würde (ich hoffe ich habe das richtig wiedergegeben [~accountid:5ef49ab24d302e0ac3183568] ). Und somit könnt ihr als Admin zumindest nachvollziehen wer der Produkt bearbeiten möchte und wer nicht. Wenn jemand bereits Schritte bearbeitet hat, wird dies in der oberen Tabelle deutlich.
* Die Produzenten bekommen eine E-Mail, wenn die Anfrage zur Bearbeitung rausgeschickt wird, in welcher sie die Möglichkeit bekommen die Anfrage anzunehmen oder abzulehnen. Benutzer haben dann nicht das Gefühl, in einem unflexiblen oder unfreundlichen Ablauf gefangen zu sein. Daher:

* Würde ich empfehlen die Plus-Buttons enabled zu lassen, auch wenn es sicher sinnvoll ist, dass der Nutzer nur eine Variante eingibt. So lange die notwendigen Felder jedoch nicht ausgefüllt sind kann er ja auch nicht zum nächsten Schritt gelangen, daher “zwingen” wir ihn ja quasi dazu alle Varianten abzuschließen, bevor er den Produktentwurf abschließen kann. Er hat so die Freiheit, die Reihenfolge der Varianten selbst festzulegen.
* Gleiches gilt für Speichern und Zurück. Das sollte immer möglich sein.
* Er muss also die Varianten immer vollständig eingeben, bevor er weiter zum nächsten Schritt gelangen kann.

Und bei dem Punkt zu dem Glas hast du auch Recht, daher wird die Option “Glas” in Schritt 12 gar nicht erst im Dropdown zur Auswahl angezeigt.
